name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.9 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 42 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 42 hours starting 2026-03-02, at wavelengths from 0.91 to 4.58 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
